tables.text: Table 1 Series of processes used to prepare film-forming solutions. Film-forming solution Layer Components and concentration in solution Solvent system Sequence of addition and processing conditions Cellulose acetate solution with thyme essential oil First (outer) layer (CA/EO) Cellulose acetate 16% (w/v); Thyme essential oil 3% (w/v) Acetone : DMSO = 1 : 2 (v/v) (1) Dissolve cellulose acetate (16% w/v) in acetone/DMSO (1:2 v/v) under magnetic stirring at room temperature until a clear homogeneous solution is obtained. (2) Add thyme essential oil (3% w/v) to the polymer solution. (3) Continue stirring for 1 h at room temperature to ensure uniform dispersion of EO. Chitosan/PVA solution containing nisin and thyme essential oil Second (inner) layer (CS/PVA/N/EO) Chitosan 2% (w/v); PVA 11% (w/v) (CS: PVA = 30:70, v/v); Nisin 15 mg/mL; Thyme essential oil 3% (w/v) Mixed aqueous system (PVA in water + chitosan in acetic acid) (1) Preparation of the PVA solution (11% w/v) in water at 90 °C for 1 h. (2) Preparation of the chitosan (2% w/v) solution in acetic acid, followed by stirring for 30 min. (3) Add nisin to the chitosan solution (15 mg/mL) and stir for an additional 30 min. (4) Mix the nisin-containing chitosan solution with the PVA solution at a 30:70 ratio and stir for 1 h at room temperature. (5) Add thyme essential oil (3% w/v) to the CS/PVA/N solution and stir for 30 min. (6) Sonicate the final CS/PVA/N/EO solution for 1 min to remove air bubbles before electrospinning.
